hero.title: The best Xfinity plans for a new apartment, ranked
hero.subtitle: We lined up the plans that fit a no-contract, self-install move-in, from our top pick to solid runners-up.
criteria.title: How we ranked them for you
criteria.items: Gig-ready speed for streaming, gaming, and working from home
No annual contract and a 5-year price guarantee
Bundle savings with a free Xfinity Mobile line
ranking.title: Your ranked recommendations
item-1.title: Xfinity Gig Internet
item-1.body: Our top pick for movers. Gig-speed fiber-powered WiFi with the xFi Gateway included, so you unbox, self-install, and stream in 4K the same day.
item-1.reasons: Up to 1 Gig download speeds with unlimited data
item-2.title: Xfinity Internet 500 Mbps
item-2.body: A fast middle ground that keeps up with every device at once, with a free Xfinity Mobile line for a year and no annual contract.
item-2.reasons: 500 Mbps, consistent even at peak hours
Free Xfinity Mobile line for 1 year
item-3.title: Xfinity Internet 300 Mbps
item-3.body: The best-value starter plan for a smaller place. Simple, reliable WiFi with same-day self-install and a free mobile line.
item-3.reasons: Free Xfinity Mobile line for 1 year
item-4.title: Xfinity Mobile - Mobile Select
item-4.body: Add this to any plan above to cut your phone bill. Unlimited talk, text, and data on the most reliable 5G network, free for a year with Internet.
item-4.reasons: Free line for a year with Internet
verdict.title: Our verdict
verdict.body: If you want future-proof speed with zero commitment, Gig Internet is the clear winner. Pair it with a free Xfinity Mobile line and your move-in setup is done.
cta.title: Set up your new place in minutes
cta.body: Pick a plan, self-install the same day, and add a free mobile line whenever you are ready.
